answer: In the abandoned brickworks (factory), Lisbeth Salander was shot three times by Alexander Zalachenko after he appeared and fired a Browning .22 calibre pistol [E1]. The first bullet hit her hip, causing her left leg to drag [E2]. The second bullet struck her shoulder, paralyzing her left arm [E2]. The third bullet penetrated her skull about an inch below the top of her left ear, causing massive trauma and making her lose consciousness [E1] . She discovered the wound in her skull after regaining enough consciousness to check herself, realizing she was touching her own brain [E3]. Overcome by weariness from these injuries, she lay down on a kitchen bench [E3].
